title: Logarithmic upper bounds and axial front selection for spatially periodic lattice Fisher--KPP equations
summary: We study the position and shape of invasion fronts for spatially periodic Fisher--KPP equations on higher-dimensional lattices, starting from localized initial data. Periodic spectral geometry determines a directional logarithmic upper bound. When the linear growth rate is independent of the propagation coordinate, we prove the matching axial Bramson correction and identify the critical pulsating front approached by the solution.
